findings.description: Direct formal-worker entry accepts formal-mode manifests without enforcing formal_execution_authorized=false or requiring separate measured-partition authorization.
Replay packet hashes are validated but are not authenticated against a verified same-case, same-cycle producer receipt.
Union ignores common_manifest_sha256 and does not fully validate record schemas and passed fields before emitting passed=true.
Prefix iteration lacks the required manifest-descriptor and immutable-assignment revalidation before each fresh resume.
Canonical scientific aggregate includes cycle, preventing byte-identical aggregates between formal cycles.
Producer and replay record indices, prefix boundaries and packet-prefix fields contain numeric-equality checks without exact integer type enforcement.
The owners list retains prior resumed owners and their state through the entire shard instead of discarding each owner before the next prefix.
